name: Spring Boot vs Express benchmark
description: Load testing the same PostgreSQL-backed workload on Java Spring Boot and Express with autocannon.
relevance: The evidence behind choosing Node for Conneczen. The decision is checkable rather than asserted.

name: PHP Job Queue System
description: A job queue and background processor built in raw PHP on MySQL, with Symfony Console for command-line management.
relevance: Queue mechanics built from primitives rather than pulled from a framework — job creation, execution, retries and process handling.

name: Organogram
description: Generates an organisation chart of employees, departments and roles from a relational structure.
relevance: The same hierarchy-traversal problem that later drove Microzen's approval routing, solved years earlier at a smaller scale.

name: Dynamic Form Builder
description: Builds forms from configurable field definitions rather than hard-coded markup.
relevance: Configurable-schema UI, which is the shape of the multi-language survey platform built later at CodersBucket.

name: Restaurant Location Viewer
description: Map-based restaurant browser integrating a REST API with interactive Mapbox visualisation.
relevance: Third-party data and mapping integration with a responsive interface.
